checks.name: Production service reads fresh hardware data from the actual official API
The production service serves the static export and enables same-origin service discovery
Two independent HTTP sessions share one durable colony
The HTTP boundary rejects resource injection and forged authentication
A real current-round assignment is visible across sessions, immutable, and does not settle early
The actual confirmed contract archive decodes three consecutive source rounds
Two independent production browsers discover live play, join the same colony, and retain distinct identities
An actual live choice locks through reload and its assignment count appears in the other browser
A browser receives a visible service failure, then recovers the same live player and shared state
Live multiplayer browser interactions produce no uncaught exceptions

limitations: This bounded smoke check does not wait ten minutes for the chosen live round to resolve. Settlement and recovery are tested with official historical rounds in the automated suite.
The service ran locally for validation; this does not establish a publicly hosted shared backend.
